about.title: About
about.summary: Software Engineer, class of 2026, focused on backend, distributed systems, and DevOps. I build backend services and REST APIs with Java/Spring Boot and Python, and work with relational and NoSQL databases, messaging systems, and cloud environments. I have built microservices and event-driven architectures. I write CI/CD pipelines with Docker and GitHub Actions and deploy applications to the cloud. I have experience with LLM integration and AI-powered product development. I care about writing secure, maintainable, and clean code.
